book.name: Luka
book.title: Cau amsǝban a nê mala LUKA

content: Zaka kum sǝn Yesu
Yesu ara aɓa nggea-là Jeriko, ndaban kútí aɓalǝi.
Ɓè ɓwa ndakam lùllǝì ama Zaka, ɓwamǝgule mala amǝcemi na sǝ yì ka, mǝkume na.
Yì ka, ɓariki nǝ̀ sǝni ko yana nda Yesu. Ɓwabunda nda kam pas mǝnana yia gbal ka à kǝ̀ earce sǝn Yesu ka. Sǝ yi Zaka, acemǝnana nkpandal na ka, gandǝ sǝnban aɓa ɓwabundǝa ɗang.
Pǝlǝa ɓangŋa, ak dǝmba, kya eauwe a nggun vwari nǝ̀ sǝni, acemǝnana àkǝ̀ banì sǝ Yesu nǝ̀ pǝlǝa.
Lang Yesu yi bwalǝna banì ka, loasǝ mǝsǝì a kùli sǝ ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Zaka, fa rǝo sùlǝî nggun! Yalung ngga, she mǝ nǝ sulǝ a ɓala mo.>>

content: Pǝlǝa sulǝo a kaurǝa gingsǝ Yesu nǝ bumpwasǝa.
Ɓwapǝndǝa mǝnana kat sǝn mǝnia ka, tita nggwani ama, <<Ɓwabura man ngga kya sulǝna a ɓala mala mǝ'cauɓikea!>>
Zaka pǝlǝa lo sǝ ne Mǝtalabangŋo ama, <<Mǝtalabangŋo, sǝni, mǝ nǝ gau girkuma mem aɓalǝu, mǝ nǝ pè amǝ'tǝ̀r kāmbe mwashat, sǝ ɓǝ̀ ǝn mbǝrina kǝɓwa ka, mǝ nǝ nyesǝi ɓwe gìr nî kusǝ ine.>>
Pǝlǝa Yesu ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Yalung ngga amsǝban yina a ɓala mǝnia ka, acemǝnana mǝnia yì ɓwa gbal ka mǝ'kà Ibǝrayim na.
Muna mala Ɓwa ka, yiu àkǝ̀ ce alta gir mǝnana ɓwàr ka, nǝ̀ amsǝi.>>

content: Kanicau arǝ pak túró nǝ boalo

Lang à nǝ̀ nggǝ kwaki kiria arǝ mǝnia yì acau ka, Yesu lidǝmba nǝ nea wia ɓe kanicau, acemǝnana anggo ka à gbàshìnà ban Urǝshalima, sǝ à kǝ sǝni kǝla Domurǝm mala Ɓakuli ka ndo nǝ̀ yiu àkǝ̀ dyadyan mǝno ka.
Pǝlǝa na ama:

content.text: Ɓè mǝtaumurǝm wari a ɓe nzali mǝsauwe nǝ̀ nggá ak gara-murǝm, sǝ nǝ̀ nyare.
Kaniama nǝ̀ o ka tunǝ atà amǝtúró male lum, gakkia wia mǝsǝboalo zǝnariya luru lum sǝ nea wia ama, <<Boalo mǝnia ka wu kǝ nggāliki nǝi, she ɓǝn nyarǝna ka.>>
Sǝ aɓwana male ka à ɓinǝi, pǝlǝa à tasǝ aɓea aɓwana atè ɓǝà kya na ama, <<Sǝm earce mǝnia yì ɓwa ka ɓǝ̀ duk murǝm ma'sǝm ɗàng.>>
Kat andǝ amani ka, mǝnia yì ɓwa ka à kya pe wi gara-murǝm, sǝ nyare a kusǝì yiu. Pǝlǝa turban atà amǝ'túró-ɓala mǝnana pākia wia boalo ka, acemǝnana nǝ̀ súrǝ̀ gir mana à kum aɓa nggāliki ka.
Mǝdǝmba yiu yi na ama, <<Ɓwamǝgule, luru mǝsǝboalo mô ka, ǝn kumǝna luru lum amurí.>>
Pǝlǝa mǝtala-ɓala male ne wi ama, <<Yàwá, mǝtúró mem mǝɓoarne! Acemǝnana a lǝmdǝ mǝsǝcau amur mǝnia bǝti ka, a nǝ duk mǝlà amur anggea-là lum.>>
Ɓaria ɓwa yiu yi na ama, <<Ɓwamǝgule, luru mǝsǝboalo mo ka, ǝn kumǝna luru tongno amurí.>>
Mǝtala-ɓala male ne wi ama, <<We ka, a nǝ bwal anggea-là tongno.>>
Pǝlǝa ɓe guro yiu yi na ama, <<Ɓwamǝgule, luru mǝsǝboalo mo nia ka, ǝn karrì aɓa bugir ǝn sǝmbǝrǝi pepe.
Ɓangciu pakkam a rǝo, acemǝnana we ka cau mò kwano na ɗang. A kǝ twal gìr mǝnana awu nǝ̀ tsǝk raka, sǝ a kǝ pwan gìr ɓaban mǝnana awu nǝ̀ ɓeal raka.>>

Mǝtala-ɓala male eari wi ama, <<Mǝ nǝ kùrro nǝ acau mǝnana à pur a kuno ka, we mǝtúró-ɓala mǝɓealɓike! A sǝlǝna she ama cau mem kwano na ɗang, ǝn nggǝ twal gìr mǝnana mǝ nǝ̀ tsǝk raka, sǝ ǝn nggǝ pwan gìr ɓaban mǝnana mǝ nǝ̀ ɓeal raka?
Sǝ palang sǝ a ɓinǝ ká tsǝkam boalo mem a banki, ace mǝnana ɓǝn nyare yiu ka, mǝ nǝ yia é nǝ mur amurí?>>
Pǝlǝa nea aɓwana mana à came abanì ka ama, <<Wu ak luru mǝsǝboalo mǝnana a buì ka, wu pè ɓwa mǝnana ndanǝ luru lum ngga.>>
Sǝ à ne wi ama, <<Ɓwamǝgule, yì ka, ndanǝ male yì luru lum mala mǝsǝboalo zǝnariya!>>
Pǝlǝa eare ama, <<Ən nggǝ na wun ama, ɓwa mǝnana ndanǝi ka, à nǝ̀ tsǝki ɓi amurí, sǝ ɓwa mǝnana pà nǝi raka, nggearǝ mǝno bǝti a buì ka à nǝ̀ é arǝì.
Sǝ amǝno yì amǝɓinǝ muram mǝnana à ear ama mǝ duk murǝm amúrià raka, wu yinǝia kani, wu yi wal-luia a ɓadǝmbam!>>

content: Aɓwana zǝkice kutio mala Yesua Urǝshalima
Anzǝm mana Yesu bangŋǝna mǝnia yì acau ka, pǝlǝa dupia wia a dǝmba aban ká a Urǝshalima.
Lang gbàshìnà Betafaji andǝ Betani aban nkono Olif ka, pǝlǝa tasǝ aɓea alaggana male ɓari.
Nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Wu kya a muna-là mǝnana a dǝm wun ngga. Kutio ma'wun ngga wun nǝ̀ kum mǝdambǝriso à kùrni, mǝnana kǝɓwa malaká eauwe a nzǝmi raka. Wu panzǝi, wu yinǝi.
Ɓǝ̀ kǝɓwa ɗì wun ama ace mana sǝ wu kǝ panzǝi le ka, wun nǝ̀ ne wi ama Ɓwamǝgule ma'sǝm
kǝ earce.>>

content: Yia mǝnana à túriá ka à wario à kya kumi kǝla mǝnana Yesu nea wia ka.
À ndarǝ panzǝ mǝdambǝriso ka, amǝtale ɗia ama, <<Ace mana sǝ wu kǝ panzǝ mǝdambǝriso?>>
À eare ama, <<Mǝtalabangŋo
kǝ earce.>>
À yiu nǝ mǝdambǝriso aban Yesu. À makki agir-koarǝu malea a nzǝmi, pǝlǝa à eamsǝ Yesu amurí.
Nda ban o ka, ɓwapǝndǝa sárǝ́ki agir-koarǝu malea amur njargula.
Lang yi bwalǝna ban mǝnana njargula dili kam aban ká Nkono Olif ka, bundǝo mala amǝkpate mǝnia ka, à tita loasǝ già nǝ bumpwasǝa aban ɓwangsǝki Ɓakuli, ace agir-ndǝlǝki mǝnana à sǝn ngga.
À kǝ bang ama,

content.text: <<Ɓwangsǝban ɓǝ pa
aban Murǝm mǝnana
kǝ yiu aɓa lullǝ
Mǝtalabangŋo ka!>>
<<Dorǝpwala nda kam a kùli
sǝ gulo ka aban Ɓakuli!>>

content: Aɓea amǝ Farisi mǝnana aɓa ɓwabundǝa ka à ne Yesu ama, <<Malǝm, sà arǝ alaggana mo ɓǝa pwalo!>>
Yesu nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Ən nggǝ bangga wun, ɓǝà duk ɗǝong ngga, atali nǝ akia wia ɓwangsǝkiban.>>

content: Yesu ɓua ace Urǝshalima
Lang Yesu yi gbashìnà Urǝshalima mǝsǝì nǝ̀ kpa arǝì ka, kara túr kúni a ɓua ace,
na ama,

content.text: <<Eare mem ngga, we Urǝshalima, yalung ngga a súrǝ́nà rǝ gir mǝnana nǝ̀ yipò nǝ dorǝpwala ka. Sǝ ado ka à sǝmbǝrǝni, mǝsǝo pà nǝ̀ gandǝ sǝne ɗàng.
Aɓea pwari nda à kǝ yiu, mǝnana aɓio amǝbura nǝ̀ yia ɓak nggea zǝ̀kì mǝcandǝe, à nǝ̀ gumbǝlio aɓalǝu, sǝ à nǝ̀ gìr amuro a koya buì ka.
À nǝ̀ yia arkio, à nǝ̀ sukkio a nzali, we wunǝ aɓwana mǝnana a ɓālǝo ka. À pà nǝ̀ ɗeki kǝ tali aban came amur ɓè ɗàng, acemǝnana we ka a súrǝ̀ pwari mǝnana Ɓakuli yiu nǝi ace amsǝo ka ɗàng.>>

content: Pǝlǝa Yesu kutio, pǝr amǝ'kúrkúró a Ndàmǝgule mala Ɓakuli.
Nea wia ama,

content.text: <<À gilǝni ama, <Ɓala mem ngga nǝ̀ duk ɓala hiwi>
<sǝ wun ngga wu nyesǝi duk npu mala amǝ'ɓǝmbǝriban!>

content: Ko aya pwari ka Yesu na aban kanigir aɓa Ndàmǝgule mala Ɓakuli. Agbani Pǝris andǝ amalǝm Nggurcau mala Musa sǝ akapana mǝnana aɓa ɓwapǝndǝa ka, à kǝ alte à nǝ̀ wal-luí.
Sǝ à kumbi ban ɗang, acemǝnana acau male pwan ɗenyicau mala ɓwapǝndǝa kat.

footnotes.text: acemǝnana mǝnia yì ɓwa gbal ka mǝ'kà Ibǝrayim na. Ko <<acemǝnana a lǝmdǝna a nda mǝ'kà Ibǝrayim mǝɓafoe.>>
Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Mat 13:12; Mar 4:28; Luk 8:18.
